visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women sit at a white marble-patterned table in a cozy, modern living room. The woman on the left wears a red sleeveless top and holds a long silver or white straw in her hand. The woman on the right wears a low-cut dark brown dress and sits before a glass of orange juice. (2) The woman on the left places the long straw against the right woman's left ear, pretending to insert it. The woman on the right takes the other straw in the glass into her mouth. They both begin a sucking motion, with the orange juice level visibly dropping rapidly as they maintain eye contact with the camera. (3) As the orange liquid reaches the bottom of the stemware glass, the women finish their exaggerated drinking performance and smile slightly. The background features a dark leather sofa and shelves containing decorative items and YouTube creator awards under warm, ambient indoor lighting, creating a high-quality production feel.
